name: El Niño / La Niña
summary: Super El Niño: ONI +2.5°C for Aug–Oct
state: NOAA's Oceanic Niño Index for August–October rose to +2.46°C, up from +2.16°C for July–September and far above the +1.5°C threshold for a strong event (NOAA CPC). Strong El Niños usually peak in northern winter; FEWS NET expects rainfall impacts in East and southern Africa through the season.
for_you: No direct UK action needed. El Niño shifts global rainfall and can raise food prices and disaster risk in exposed regions.

sources.title: FEWS NET — 2026–2027 El Niño food security impacts

why: ENSO reshapes global weather for a year at a time — droughts, floods, hurricanes and crop yields.
drivers: Pacific trade winds and ocean heat content.
